latency_protocol: latency_us: time.perf_counter(), mean over 500 test flows, one flow per call (batch size 1), single CPU thread (torch.set_num_threads(1), n_jobs=1), 1 warm-up call; latency_batched_us: 500 flows per call, median of 5 repetitions, divided by the number of flows
split_protocol: random: stratified 70/15/15 per run, validation split 50/50 into selection and calibration; device: leave-one-device-out, one run per held-out device, remaining devices split 85/15 train/validation
